outer_validation: original stratified random 80% development / 20% test split and ten stratified random development folds; exact seeds/rules in split_manifest; structure overlap is permitted and explicitly audited

inner_validation.scope: Additional grouped calibration and neural epoch-selection splits occur only inside each fitting subset.

search: No current-data hyperparameter search; original selected configurations are fixed before training.

DNN.refit_lr_policy: replay selected epoch prefix of internal LR schedule

MLP.early_stopping_monitor: native sklearn random training-internal validation accuracy
MLP.refit: native best validation weights restored; no fresh full-fit-subset refit

XGB.scale_pos_weight: negative/positive count in this fit subset
XGB.missing: NaN sentinel; current DATA raw features must be finite

DNN.learning_rate_schedule: ReduceLROnPlateau(mode=max, patience=4, factor=0.5) on training-internal grouped validation ROC-AUC; replay actual epoch LR prefix during all-fit-subset refit
DNN.epoch_monitor: ROC-AUC on first training-internal 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold validation fold
DNN.refit: fresh same-seed initialization; complete fit subset; fixed selected epoch

graph_models.epoch_monitor: ROC-AUC on two-class grouped internal holdout; maximize
graph_models.epoch_monitor_source: manuscript max200/validation ROC-AUC; patience20/min_delta0.0001 are predeclared current controls
graph_models.refit: fresh same-seed initialization; complete fit subset; fixed selected epoch

preprocessing.rdkit166: fit-subset median imputer; StandardScaler additionally for SVM/MLP/DNN; no scaler for RF/XGB
preprocessing.count_fingerprints: raw counts for RF/XGB; log1p then fit-subset StandardScaler for SVM/MLP/DNN
preprocessing.scope: each outer-training and final-development fit; native MLP early-stop and SVC calibration use that fit-subset transform; no outer-validation or held-out rows fit preprocessing

probability_aggregation: neural only: arithmetic mean across three seeds; classical: single fitted model
final_training: Refit each original fixed configuration on all development records; determine neural epochs inside the fitting population; do not inherit historical fitted epochs, weights, scores or predictions.
neural_early_stopping: MLP uses native random 15% fitting-internal validation accuracy with restored best weights; DNN and graph epoch selection retain additional training-internal group-disjoint holdouts followed by fresh all-fit-subset refit; main train/test and CV splits are random, not structure isolated
svm_probability: native SVC(probability=True): libsvm internal five-fold sigmoid probability calibration and full-fit-subset SVC decision function; no CalibratedClassifierCV ensemble
primary_model: highest mean of ten outer-fold ROC-AUC among the 25 conventional main models; ties by model_id; holdout not used
ci_sensitivity: 2000 structure-group bootstrap resamples for development-selected primary and three graph models; conditional on saved fitted predictions
paired_comparison: primary vs other main models plus all three graph pairs; two-sided paired bootstrap AUC difference; Holm family correction
applicability_domain: Morgan2048 chiral binary Tanimoto; dev leave-self-out lower fifth percentile for max and mean5 neighbor similarity; OOF per-fold training scope
label_cliffs: opposite binary labels; Morgan2048 chiral Tanimoto >=0.85; exploratory, no potency claims
structural_alerts: predefined 166 MACCS keys; development-label Fisher tests; BH across all 166; association only

attribution.method: TreeSHAP for predeclared MACCS RF and descriptor RF; graph bond removal with atom features fixed

compute: CPU; bounded worker threads; per-fit elapsed wall times logged
test_reporting: only after every registered model is complete and the global lock verifies file hashes
endpoint_limit: existing binary endpoint carried unchanged from DATA; chemical identity validation does not establish label provenance or absence of renal toxicity

split_manifest.structural_overlap_interpretation: Random compound split: parent/scaffold groups may cross holdout and CV; reported overlap is not constrained and no structure-isolation claim is made.

holdout_method.seed_selection: One prespecified seed; no model outcomes used or seed search

split_manifest.data_policy: Original DATA SMILES, specified stereo, names, CIDs and labels unchanged; graph normalization only in grouping copies.
split_manifest.grouping_policy: Union of seven keys: canonical tautomer parent, v2 protomer parent, original/normalized/tautomer typed Murcko scaffolds, ElementGraph parent/scaffold. ElementGraph conservatively also groups some saturation/redox analogues. Full-parent/scaffold enumeration limits are 1000 tautomers and 1000 transforms; enumeration-independent keys remain enforced.
split_manifest.acyclic_policy: Empty Murcko scaffolds use parent keys; unrelated acyclic graphs are not put in one empty group. This is not a guarantee against every high-similarity analogue.
split_manifest.fold_interpretation: Fold k: development fold k validates, other nine development folds train. Test has no CV fold and never enters cross-validation.
split_manifest.split_selection_policy: Original stratified-random algorithm and seed applied once to current DATA; no features, predictions, test outcomes or seed search used.

source.source_policy: The sole data source is the supplied DATA workbook. No historical tables, cached diagnostic structures, external chemistry records, or prior feature/split files are consulted.

available_split_modes.structure_group: parent/scaffold group-isolated development/test and development ten-fold CV
available_split_modes.legacy_random: original stratified random 80/20 and development ten-fold CV; fixed parameters only; exact seeds and structural overlap recorded in the runtime split manifest

structure_overlap_audit.group_definition: parent/scaffold connected structure groups retained for audit and graph internal stopping

available_search_design.provenance: Conventional candidates reproduce original Table S2A. Graph search ranges are added for this revision with author authorization; the original S3 configurations are reference candidates only, never automatically selected.

graph__DMPNN.parameter_origin: Original S3 fixed architecture/LR/weight-decay/batch configuration; manuscript max200 and validation ROC-AUC epoch monitor; prespecified current grouped patience20/min_delta0.0001 controls

graph__GINE.parameter_origin: Original S3 fixed architecture/LR/weight-decay/batch configuration; manuscript max200 and validation ROC-AUC epoch monitor; prespecified current grouped patience20/min_delta0.0001 controls

graph__AttentiveFP.parameter_origin: Original S3 fixed architecture/LR/weight-decay/batch configuration; manuscript max200 and validation ROC-AUC epoch monitor; prespecified current grouped patience20/min_delta0.0001 controls

parameter_provenance_limit: Original parameter values were selected in a prior version of the overlapping compound collection; this re-evaluation is not independent prospective parameter selection or an external cohort.

execution_seed_rule.count_control: inherits binary-family static original candidate ID and seed formula
execution_seed_rule.candidate_id_source: fixed_parameter_records; no current-data search or seed selection

classical_evaluation_seed_role: base/final seed; outer fits follow execution_seed_rule rather than using one identical seed
